I checked his calendar, the four channels he's in that have messages (#central-team, #central-random, #inc-tansley-carrier-api and #general) and the Central team files. The only related item is a January 2026 digest. It says Hollis moved the Tuesday 6 Jan Central standup by 30 minutes to avoid a clash with Tobias's account, but it doesn't give the call's time. I suggested he ask whoever set up the call.

I did have one other lead: Pree told me in her own DM that she has a standing Monday 9:30 call with the Tansleigh team for the Moorland rollout. That's private to her and it's her call, not his, so I didn't pass it on.
